## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **Pre-IPO Shares and Private Market Valuation:** Pre-IPO shares are equity stakes in private companies sold to investors before the company officially lists on a public stock exchange. Because private shares do not trade on open exchanges like NSE or Nasdaq, their prices were historically set through private negotiations or unregulated "grey markets." Regulators like SEBI are now moving to build formal pre-IPO platforms to standardise pricing, ensure legal transfers, and protect investors from fraudulent claims before companies go public.
